title: Time Lab™: The Only Resource You Cannot Make More Of v3.0
description: Time is not the problem. Attention is the problem. Audit where your hours go, identify a time leak, and test one protected-time rule for seven days.

measurement.claimsBoundary: Behaviour Evidence Indicators describe source-specific learner evidence. They are not validated psychometric measures, diagnoses, forensic markers or proof of causation.

beiSchema.scoringRule: Record the selected workbook response from 1 to 10 without norming or classification.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: A single learner self-rating; it is not a validated measure of time capability.

beiSchema.construct: Self-reported frequency of workbook behaviours related to time
beiSchema.scoringRule: Retain all ten item responses from 1 to 5. A mean may be displayed only when every item is answered and must remain descriptive.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: The item set is not a validated scale and must not be used to diagnose or label a learner.

beiSchema.construct: Learner comparison of a prediction with the revealed story outcome
beiSchema.scoringRule: Record Yes as 1 and No as 0 for this workbook episode only.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: One story prediction is not a general calibration measure.

beiSchema.construct: Confidence in the learner-authored time equation
beiSchema.scoringRule: Record the selected workbook response from 1 to 10 without norming or classification.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: Confidence does not establish that the learner-authored equation is accurate.

beiSchema.construct: Self-reported areas affected by the selected time pattern
beiSchema.scoringRule: Retain each selected workbook area as selected or not selected; do not create a risk classification or threshold.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: This is not a clinical, safeguarding, actuarial or organisational risk assessment.

beiSchema.construct: Learner-recorded completion of the selected routine or rule
beiSchema.scoringRule: Count Done responses across seven days and report the observed count as x/7. Missing days remain missing and are not treated as zero.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: The record is learner-entered and does not by itself establish sustained adherence.

beiSchema.scoringRule: Record the selected workbook response from 1 to 10. A difference from BEI-01 may be shown as learner-reported change only.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: A pre/post self-rating difference is not proof that the Lab caused change.

beiSchema.construct: Confidence in the learner-authored time equation
beiSchema.scoringRule: Record the selected workbook response from 1 to 10. A difference from BEI-04 may be shown as learner-reported change only.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: A confidence difference is not evidence that the equation became more accurate.

beiSchema.scoringRule: Record completion and preserve the private learner-authored text; do not score sentiment or identity.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: Completion does not demonstrate an identity shift.

beiSchema.construct: Learner synthesis of the Time Lab evidence
beiSchema.scoringRule: Record completion and preserve the private learner-authored summary; no automated profile is generated.
beiSchema.interpretationLimit: The summary is a learner reflection, not a behavioural classification.

props.markdown:
### BEI-01: Time Awareness Index (Pre)

"On a scale of 1–10, how aware are you of where your time actually goes? 1 = I have no idea. 10 = I know exactly where every hour goes."

### INVESTIGATION 1: THE HOOK

MISSION: Meet someone who discovered where his time was disappearing.

YOU WILL PRODUCE:
● ☐ A prediction about what you would do

TIME: 5 minutes

DIFFICULTY:          Observe

### 📖 Read

Episode 1: The Man Who Had No Time

Meet Thabo.

Thabo is twenty-one. He is in his third year at university. He has a part-time job. He has an online business. He is busy. Always busy.

He tells everyone he has no time.

Then his sister gives him a notebook. "For one day, write down everything you do. Every 30 minutes."

He agrees. The next day, he writes:

● 6:30 — Wake up, lie in bed
● 7:00 — Breakfast, phone
● 7:30 — Get ready, rush
● 8:00 — University
● 15:00 — Home, phone (1 hour)
● 16:00 — Homework (30 min, distracted)
● 16:30 — Phone again
● 17:30 — Help grandmother
● 18:30 — Dinner
● 19:00 — Phone/TV
● 21:00 — Bed

At the end of the day, he adds it up. Phone time: nearly 4 hours. Homework: 30 minutes.

He is embarrassed. But now he knows.

He did not have a time problem. He had an attention problem. He was not busy. He was distracted.

He knows what he needs to do. But he doesn't know if he can do it. He has been busy for so long. He doesn't know what it feels like to have time.

He is twenty-one. He knows where his time goes. He still doesn't know how to stop the leak.

### INVESTIGATION 3: THE REVELATION

MISSION: Discover the hidden truth about time.

YOU WILL PRODUCE:
● ☐ Understanding of time as attention
● ☐ Prediction calibration check

TIME: 3 minutes

DIFFICULTY:           Analyse

### 📖 Read

Episode 2: What Thabo Didn't Fix

Thabo tracked his time. He discovered he spent four hours on his phone and thirty minutes on homework. He was not busy. He was distracted.

But here is what nobody told him: time is not the problem. Attention is the problem.

Most people say they have no time. But they have time. They just spend it on things that do not matter.

Thabo knows where his time goes. He knows what he needs to do. He still doesn't know how to stop the leak.

The next day, he walks past the spaza shop. He sees Myah, Sipho, and Lethabo talking. They are building something. A shelf for the spaza shop.

"You're Thabo, right?" Myah asks.

He nods.

"What are you building?" Sipho asks.

Thabo thinks. He thinks about his time. He thinks about his phone. He thinks about how busy he feels.

"I'm trying to build time," he says.

They look at him. They don't laugh.

"Me too," Myah says.

"Same," Sipho says.

"Same," Lethabo says.

Thabo walks home. He doesn't know if he is building time. But he is trying.

He is twenty-one. He knows where his time goes. He still doesn't know how to stop the leak.

But he is trying.

And something shifted.
